properties.title: Traffic Impacts: Shoulder and lane closures with flagging Monday-Friday 9:00 am to 3:00 pm.
properties.body:
We're improving safety for people walking, biking or rolling by installing a new pedestrian-activated crossing, known as a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon, on Hall Boulevard (OR 141) at SW Omara Street and upgrading the existing signalized crosswalk at SW Fanno Creek Trail.
